Job Title: Full-Stack Developer - Frontend Focused 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Continental US 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
The Full-Stack Developer - Frontend-Focused will design, develop, integrate, test, and maintain responsive web applications supporting manufacturing and industrial operations. The role emphasizes ASP.NET MVC and modern .NET frontend development while also contributing to APIs, data access, deployment, and application troubleshooting.
  
 The ideal candidate combines strong frontend development skills with practical full-stack experience and can translate user and operational needs into intuitive, reliable, and maintainable software solutions.
  

 Responsibilities: 

 Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using ASP.NET MVC, C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, and/or .NET 6+.
 Build reusable, component-based user interfaces using JavaScript and/or TypeScript, CSS or comparable styling frameworks, state-management approaches, and sound UI/UX principles.
 Develop dashboards and interactive visualizations using Chart.js, Telerik, DevExpress, or similar technologies
 Develop and integrate RESTful services using ASP.NET Web API; support data access through Entity Framework and SQL; and deploy or troubleshoot applications in IIS environments.
 Participate in Agile planning, design and code reviews, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation, Git-based development, CI/CD activities, and the use of AI/LLM tools in software workflows.
 

 Qualifications: 

 Required:  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.
 Three or more years of relevant software development experience.
 Strong proficiency with ASP.NET MVC, C#, and modern .NET technologies, with demonstrated experience developing responsive, interactive, and component-based web applications.
 Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript, CSS or styling frameworks, state management, and data-visualization libraries such as Chart.js, Telerik, or DevExpress.
 Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, collaboration, lifecycle, Git, CI/CD, Agile, manufacturing-environment, and AI/LLM workflow capabilities.

 
 Desired: 


 Five or more years of relevant software development experience.
 Experience developing ASP.NET Web APIs, using Entity Framework and SQL, and deploying applications through IIS.
 Experience developing software for manufacturing, production, test, or industrial operations.
 Familiarity with accessibility, usability testing, design systems, or frontend performance optimization.
 Experience with automated testing, application monitoring, structured logging, or production troubleshooting.


 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$65,700 - $134,400 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
